dog.description_text: Spring is the purrfect companion to add a little extra spunk to your day! Originally adopted as a kitten, Spring recently made her way back to ARF after being brought in as a stray. Now a bit more mature, Spring has left the kitten chaos behind and is ready to find a warm lap to curl up in and a loving home to call her own!
